response.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's core move — urging readers to remember a date and spread the message so "everyone knows what is coming" — is loosely echoed by T4-006983, which is simply a "Daily reminder" with a link, and by T4-009040's "Save the date!" framing, though that one is an explicit donation appeal for veterans rather than an ominous countdown [T4-006983](#T4-006983) [T4-009040](#T4-009040). The new post's call to "Do your part. Share this" also parallels T4-002543's "Spread it, speak up for America!" appeal, but that post names a specific cause (#JusticeForTwinFalls) while the new post gives no issue, target, or explanation of what 11/3 signifies [T4-002543](#T4-002543). The conspiratorial "truth needs witnesses" language is thematically adjacent to T4-005682's talk of hidden "truths" that officials "dont want known," yet that post identifies named targets and predicts trials, whereas the new post names none [T4-005682](#T4-005682). T4-007098 shares only a generic "this is important, read/share it" tone and adds a concrete claim about abuse that must end, which the new post lacks [T4-007098](#T4-007098). Overall the similarities are limited to vague urgency-and-sharing rhetoric; none of the retrieved posts mentions 11/3 or clarifies the new post's meaning.
